fields.climate: temperate with mild winters and cool summers; about 50% of days are overcast
fields.terrain: mostly flat with low hills in southwest
fields.hazards: very large tidal variation and fast currents can make local waters dangerous
fields.farm: tomatoes, greenhouse flowers, sweet peppers, eggplant, fruit; Guernsey cattle
fields.exports: aircraft, photo lab equipment, clocks, ships, paintings
fields.languages: English, French, Norman-French dialect spoken in country districts
fields.religions: Protestant (Anglican, Presbyterian, Baptist, Congregational, Methodist), Roman Catholic
fields.legal: customary system based on Norman customary law; includes elements of the French civil code and English common law
